newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra plans total media market rules-paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra plans total media market rules-paper.

text.p: The Australian government privately supported a new system of media ownership rules which would limit the amount of the total media market any one proprietor could own, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Friday.

"Senior ministers, including the Prime Minister (John Howard), the Treasurer, Mr Costello and the Minister for Communications, Senator Alston, are all privately indicating in-principle support," the Herald said.
"The system is the government-preferred option most likely to emerge from a planned media policy review," it said.
